definition: a musician who plays the harp
description: Inside a wet fish market hall, a young woman with pinned-up red hair, in a long dark green velvet dress and green heels, sits on a stool and plays a tall golden harp, swaying as she plucks the strings, with a pair of yellow rubber boots beside her. Behind her, men in orange waterproof overalls stand at steel tables piled with fish and shellfish on ice and sing along, one holding up a big fish. Hanging lamps light the hall, steam drifts in the air and a seagull sits on a beam.
